data.gist: BMAC and BMAX were prepared from iliac crest marrow of a single 50-year-old donor with high senescent-cell burden; injectate was 100 µL fresh, with cell counts not enumerated.
data.plain: All material came from one consented donor (chosen because she had among the highest senescent-cell levels, a worst-case scenario) so BMAC and BMAX could be compared from the same marrow without donor variability. BMAC was made by two-step centrifugation of 50 mL aspirate; BMAX from Jamshidi-needle bone cores processed in a proprietary device to 3 mL. Everything was injected fresh (100 µL per knee) without freezing; the authors note they did not count total nucleated cells or MSCs in the injectate.
